thread.title: Wall Street Mixed as Financials Lift Dow But Nasdaq Wilts Under Tech Pressure

author: MT Newswires
title: Wall Street Mixed as Financials Lift Dow But Nasdaq Wilts Under Tech Pressure
text:
Shutterstock photo Wall Street was mixed in late trading Wednesday, with gains in financials propping up the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 while losses in information technology stocks, the top performing sector over the past year, dragged down the Nasdaq Composite.
On the day, stocks struggled to gain traction after U.S. Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross sparked fears of a trade war with China in earlier comments. Financials and telecoms led gains among the S&P groups but declines in heavyweight Apple ( AAPL ) sent the tech group into the red.
